headline: Switched on Pop’s Nate Sloan and Charlie Harding love fresh vegetables and guitar pedals
summary: Switched on Pop hosts Nate Sloan and Charlie Harding dissect popular songs. The acclaimed music podcast reportedly originated from Carly Rae Jepsen's hit 'Call Me Maybe'. They explore the musical theory and choices behind pop perfection.

headline: Star Wars: Ahsoka season 2 and Starfighter get teased at D23
summary: Lucasfilm offered a sneak peek at Star Wars: Ahsoka season two during D23. A trailer for the new season dropped, set for a January 20th, 2027 debut. The clip teases a darker, witchcraft-filled expansion of the Star Wars universe.

headline: Disney D23 2026: Everything announced for Star Wars, Marvel, and more
summary: D23 2026 revealed the cast for Marvel's X-Men movie and a new Avengers: Doomsday trailer. Fans got a first look at the VisionQuest TV show coming to Disney Plus. Star Wars updates included a teaser for Ahsoka season two and Star Wars: Starfighter.

headline: I finally found a magnetic phone grip I never want to remove
summary: The author, previously skeptical, discovered a magnetic phone grip they now adore. Past OhSnap accessories were deemed overpriced and slightly flawed. OhSnap's new $50 Snap Grip Stand finally won them over.

headline: I Love Handhelds, But I’m Worried the RAM Crisis is Going to Kill Them
summary: Handheld gaming PCs have consistently improved year-over-year. Skyrocketing RAM prices pose a significant threat to their future. The RAM crisis could make handhelds less appealing for both gamers and manufacturers.

headline: Star Trek’s Babs Olusanmokun on the End of Strange New Worlds: ‘I Don't See It as a Final Episode’
summary: Babs Olusanmokun, who portrays Dr. M'Benga, shared his perspective on Strange New Worlds. He stated he doesn't view the recent episode as a definitive finale. His comments hint at potential continuation for the Star Trek series.

headline: Who Needs Wolverine? Why We're Pumped for Marvel's X-Men Reboot | D23 2026
summary: Marvel's X-Men reboot was a highlight at D23 2026. The upcoming film is notable for its distinct lack of Wolverine. This absence is cited as a key reason for excitement about the fresh take on the franchise.

headline: I Hope GTA 6 Borrows a Lot From GTA 4
summary: The author is revisiting Grand Theft Auto 4, playing it for the first time since 2008. They've discovered numerous elements they hope Rockstar incorporates into GTA 6. This suggests a desire for specific mechanics or narrative depth from the classic title.

headline: Jason Arday death 'tragedy on so many levels' says PM
summary: The Prime Minister commented on the death of former Cambridge professor Jason Arday. Andy Burnham described Arday's passing as a 'sad and sorry state of affairs'. His death is being widely mourned as a tragedy.

headline: Analysis: Arday's death will send shockwaves through a divided academia
summary: Jason Arday's death is expected to profoundly impact the academic community. He was among less than 1% of Black professors in UK universities. Education Editor Branwen Jeffreys highlights his significant and visible minority status.

headline: Powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake kills at least 47 in Indonesia
summary: A devastating 7.7 magnitude earthquake has struck Indonesia. The powerful quake has reportedly killed at least 47 people. A search and rescue operation is actively underway in Flores to find survivors.

headline: Thousands of Bonnie Tyler fans line the streets as coffin taken to Swansea home
summary: Thousands of Bonnie Tyler fans lined the streets of Swansea to pay their respects. The 'Total Eclipse of the Heart' singer passed away last month in Portugal. Her coffin was transported to her home in Swansea.
